title: fix: one smooth lotus everywhere, at the original line weight
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #15842. That PR fixed the lotus at the source; this swaps every other copy so only one lotus is left in the repo, and takes the line back to its original weight.

- Drops the 25% stroke from `brand/mark.svg` and rebuilds the kit; the smooth drawing, `BrandMark`, `AppBrand` and the ops headers from #15842 stay as they are
- Regenerates favicons, apple touch, PWA and maskable icons for Enter, gen, the website, the ops apps and the 13 apps under `apps/`, plus the shared OG image (all byte-identical)
- Website `logo.svg`, Enter's Pollinations model logo and the chat logo use the kit mark; the changelog generator uses the kit's white lockup
- Drops the unused `apps/chat/public/logo-text.svg`

Before this, the apps carried three different lotus sets: the thin amber one, an older lime-green one, and the website's pixel one. Browsers cache favicons for a while, so the old icon can linger after deploy.

gist.headline: One lotus, many tabs
gist.blurb: The lotus has stopped changing outfits between tabs. Its smooth drawing and original line weight now carry across the site, Enter, gen, and the apps.
gist.summary: Rebuilt the shared brand kit with the smooth lotus at its original line weight and regenerated favicons, touch icons, PWA icons, logos, and OG imagery across Enter, gen, the website, operations tools, and 13 apps.
gist.impact: Users will see a consistent lotus across those sites and apps, though cached browser favicons may take a while to catch up.
gist.visual_concept: Polli checks a row of small browser tabs and app icons, each showing the same smooth lotus. A single lotus flower growing beside a retro workstation represents the shared source; her tiny magnifying glass nods to the original line weight.
